name: Home screen pop-out
summary: The home screen can be popped out into its own small window that keeps its stats live in the background.
description: One faint pop-out control floats at the top right of the home screen (the desktop home has no top bar since 2026-09-30) and opens a menu: pop out home, wallboard, then every home board. Pop out home opens the home screen alone in its own browser window, titled carnivore stats, with no drawer and a compact bar. The window keeps its numbers live over the same events feed as the main window, opens no terminal and never votes on a pane size, remembers its size and place, re-lays out to whatever size it is dragged to, and has a focus main window link that raises the window that opened it. It uses the sign-in the main window already holds; signed out it says to sign in from the main window. Wallboard opens the same page as a wallboard: only the home analytics widgets, no bar, no handles, read only, sized to fill the window and following the synced home layout live; a board in the menu opens the wallboard for that board. Analytics widgets can also be placed beside terminals in a saved terminal layout.
where: The home screen's top right corner: the faint open in a new window icon, which opens the menu.
The popped-out window's top bar: focus main window.
how_to: Point at the top right corner of the home screen and click the open in a new window icon; choose pop out home, and a window titled carnivore stats opens.
Leave it open behind other windows; its numbers keep updating, and it catches up by itself after a sleep, a dropped network or a server restart.

If a strip reading offline, data may be stale appears in its bottom left corner, the window has lost its live link for that long: press retry, or reload it. If a pill reading new version available or update ready appears at the top, press reload to run the new install.
Click focus main window to raise the app window that opened it.

Choose wallboard from the same menu to open the home analytics widgets alone in a window for a big screen, or choose a board to open that board's wallboard; changes to the home layout in the main window appear there live.
In edit layout on a terminal page, open the widget gallery and add an analytics widget beside the terminal.
examples: Keep token use and cost visible on a second monitor while agents run in the main window.
Put a cost and tokens wallboard on a wall screen while the main window drives the agents.
media_exempt: the visible effect is a second browser window, which the screenshot capture harness does not open
